typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tableName as string
}
source(output(
		MANDT as string,
		ingestion_ts as timestamp,
		source_system as string,
		source_table as string,
		batch_id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	columnDelimiter: ',',
	escapeChar: '\\',
	quoteChar: '\"',
	firstRowAsHeader: true,
	fileSystem: 'bronze',
	folderPath: (concat($tableName, '/')),
	wildcardFileName: '*.csv',
	recursive: true) ~> BronzeSource
BronzeSource filter(ingestion_ts >= addDays(currentTimestamp(), -30)) ~> Last30Days
Last30Days sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	truncate: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	format: 'delimited',
	columnDelimiter: ',',
	escapeChar: '\\',
	quoteChar: '\"',
	firstRowAsHeader: true,
	fileSystem: 'silver',
	folderPath: (concat($tableName, '/')),
	fileName: (concat($tableName, '.csv'))) ~> SilverSink
